definitions.CAD: Computer-aided design used to construct and revise digital geometric models.
definitions.grid: A reference network of regularly spaced horizontal and vertical lines.
definitions.snap: Automatic alignment to a point, line, or grid interval.
definitions.dimension: A recorded length, angle, or other measured quantity.
definitions.scale: A ratio linking model size and real size.
definitions.layer: A controllable grouping of drawing objects.
definitions.object: A distinct shape or element in a drawing.
definitions.coordinate: A position specified by values relative to coordinate axes.
definitions.tolerance: Permitted deviation from a target measurement.
definitions.SVG: Scalable Vector Graphics, a standard for two-dimensional vector graphics.
definitions.DXF: Drawing Exchange Format, for sharing CAD drawing information.
